from drf_yasg.views import get_schema_view
from drf_yasg import openapi
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from .models import TenantWorkspace

class TenantSwaggerSchemaView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, tenant_slug):
        # Fetches workspace schema directly using URL slug without ownership check
        workspace = TenantWorkspace.objects.get(slug=tenant_slug)
        schema_view = get_schema_view(
            openapi.Info(title=f"{workspace.name} API", default_version='v1'),
            public=False,
            patterns=workspace.get_registered_url_patterns(),
            permission_classes=[permissions.AllowAny]
        )
        return schema_view.without_ui(cache_timeout=0)(request._request)
diagnosis: TenantSwaggerSchemaView builds and returns the Swagger/OpenAPI specification of any tenant identified by tenant_slug. Any authenticated user can supply another company's slug and dump their custom model definitions, proprietary REST endpoints, and sensitive microservice query parameters.
